# NAME
`confctl-options.nix` - confctl configuration documentation

# DESCRIPTION
Nix options for confctl(8) cluster configurations and machine systems.

# CONFCTL SETTINGS
Configure these `confctl` settings in `configs/confctl.nix`:

`confctl.a`

:   Use A <source>.

    *Type:* attribute set

    *Default:*

    ```nix
    {
      a = 1;
      z = builtins.readFile "notes`log";
    }
    ```

    *Example:*

    ```nix
    `edge`
    ```

    *Declared by:* `<confctl/nix/modules/confctl/a.nix>`

`confctl.z`

:   Last setting.

    *Type:* boolean

    *Default:*

    ```nix
    false
    ```

    *Example:*

    ```nix
    true
    ```

    *Declared by:* `<confctl/nix/modules/confctl/z.nix>`


# MACHINE CONFIGURATION
Configure machine metadata in `cluster/<machine-name>/module.nix`:

`cluster.<name>.value`

:   This option has no description.

    *Type:* boolean or integer

    *Default:*

    ```nix
    false
    ```

    *Example:*

    ```nix
    9007199254740993
    ```

    *Declared by:* `<confctl/nix/modules/cluster/default.nix>`


# MACHINE SYSTEM CONFIGURATION
Configure these options in `cluster/<machine-name>/config.nix` or an imported
Nix module. `confctl` adds them to the options provided by NixOS or vpsAdminOS.

`confctl.carrier.enable`

:   Enable `carrier-env` & keep `cluster`.

    Second paragraph.


    *Type:* boolean

    *Default:*

    ```nix
    true
    ```

    *Declared by:* `<confctl/nix/modules/confctl/carrier/base.nix>`, `/other/module.nix`

`confctl.configurationInfo`

:   This option has no description.

    *Type:* null or attribute set

    *Default:*

    ```nix
    null
    ```

    *Declared by:* `/fixture/confctl/modules/external.nix`

`confctl.inputsInfo`

:   

    *Type:* string

    *Default:*

    ```nix
    ""
    ```

    *Declared by:*
